{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of Japanese language ''Advanced Generation'' home video releases}} {{incomplete|2=VHS releases}} The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire|Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation]]'' of {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==Volume releases== ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire|Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation]]'' was divided into four sets that were released by {{wp|Media Factory}} and [[Shogakukan]]. It contains almost all the [[List of Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire episodes|192 episodes]] between them. All the DVDs were released for rental only. ===Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation=== Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation was released by {{wp|Media Factory}} and [[Shogakukan]] in 2006. It consists of 15 volumes with 45 episodes across them combined. ''[[AG026|Attack of the Konohana Family!]]'' was released separately.
